profile_text.body:
GitHub, listed here as GitHub (Microsoft), describes itself on its site as an AI-powered developer platform used by millions of developers, businesses, and the largest open source community, which it says build software that advances humanity. The company says it provides AI and automation tools intended to help users build and ship software faster, from a first line of code through to final deployment.

The one product tracked for GitHub is GitHub Copilot for Education, listed under education and research AI. According to the product listing, it offers code suggestions and chat, is aimed at verified students and educators aged 13 and older, is governed by GitHub Education terms, and is free for verified students and educators 13 and up.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
